evaluation_scope: Computational predictions and constraint satisfaction; no new experimental measurements.
selection_rule: Prefer designs meeting all public requirements, then equal mean percentile ranks across objectives; earliest candidate breaks ties. The Agent retains its own final choice.
comparison_rule: Report raw per-case objective values, validity, feasibility, nondominance and actual costs. Internal search ranks are not comparable across methods.

decision_schema.output: last physical signal; input names appear in task.inputs.input_signals

scope: Steady-state Cello UCF model. Boolean accuracy and quantitative function are reported separately. Sensor-strain and plasmid backgrounds are not newly built.
